author: reek
body: The main UI renderer for Codex Circuits. Draws the toolbar, tab bar, schematic canvas with demo circuit, sidebar with component list, and status bar -- all to a framebuffer for GOP display and screenshot.

author: reek
body: A pre-built demo schematic: STM32 microcontroller with USB connector, decoupling caps, crystal oscillator, reset circuit, and LED indicators. Placed at screen coordinates for visual impact.
